description:
Shared SSE cancellation plus one application-owned drain deadline guarantees clean exit even when an ordinary connection cannot finish voluntarily.

## Background

The server must stop accepting new work, let cooperative streams and ordinary requests finish, and still bound process exit when a connection stalls. The timeout and forced-close count must describe the same boundary; separate application and server-handle timers can start at different moments and report a forced close before the connection's actual drain allowance expires.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Adds `axum-server` 0.8 and `tokio-util`; defines one application constant `GRACEFUL_DRAIN_TIMEOUT = Duration::from_secs(5)`. One `CancellationToken` is cloned into AppState/router/SSE, and one `axum_server::Handle` owns listener/connection shutdown. Registered Ctrl-C or Unix terminate errors propagate.
- [hard] REQ-02: On signal, cancels the token first so `sse::change_stream` reaches EOF and its 15-second keepalive stops, then calls `handle.graceful_shutdown(None)` to stop acceptance and begin indefinite graceful draining. The application owns the sole five-second boundary; at expiry it samples the live connection count and calls `handle.shutdown()` exactly when survivors remain. Ordinary connections receive at most five seconds from that boundary, the sampled count identifies the connections whose survival triggers forced closure, and the server future returns `Ok`. Logs include the signal, deadline, connection count before and at expiry, forced-close path, and clean completion.
- [hard] REQ-03: A Unix real-process test opens `/api/events/stream`, observes the initial or keepalive connection, and starts a deliberately non-completing ordinary response/body or stalled connection. After SIGTERM it requires SSE EOF promptly, the ordinary connection forcibly closed at the five-second deadline, socket closure, and process exit 0 in strictly less than ten seconds—never signal death, test-side kill, or 137.
- [hard] REQ-04: Fixtures cover multiple SSE plus completing and non-completing ordinary requests, connection-count/deadline logs, no child, valid repository, and immediate restart. Cross-platform tests cover token, Ctrl-C, and handle behavior without Unix-only APIs.
- [hard] REQ-05: The new `axum-server` and `tokio-util` versions are pinned by Cargo.lock, compile on the declared MSRV, and pass `cargo audit -D warnings`; no advisory allowlist is added.

## Notes

Blast radius: `crates/server/src/main.rs`, `routes.rs` and `AppState`, `sse.rs`, optional shutdown or test-only routes/modules, `crates/server/tests/`, `crates/server/Cargo.toml`, workspace `Cargo.lock`, and Rust security-audit evidence. Domain and storage semantics are unchanged.
title: Implement graceful jit-server process shutdown
